title: Navigation & Wayfinding: overview film
description: Menus, breadcrumbs and pagination. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 34 seconds: the 24 Navigation & Wayfinding elements of Desiderio for TYPO3 v14, including navbar with dropdowns, breadcrumb, map embed, profile header, search header, tabs. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: In a deep page tree, visitors get lost when menus and breadcrumbs disagree.
Navigation and Wayfinding has 24 elements for menus, headers and paths through a site.
Dropdown menus, breadcrumbs, maps, profile headers, a search header and tabs.
Every element uses the same design tokens as the rest of the site.
